# Grid-Based Logic Games Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Constraint Games
*Games where numbers must be placed or satisfied according to mathematical or positional rules*
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan
- Five Cells
- Yosenabe

## 2. Region Division & Partitioning Games
*Games where the grid must be divided into defined regions or shapes*
- Fillomino
- Shikaku
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Five Cells
- Choco Banana
- Nuritwin

## 3. Path & Loop Drawing Games
*Games where players trace paths, loops, or connected routes through the grid*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Hebi
- Nagareru
- Suraromu
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Dotchi-Loop
- Pencils

## 4. Shading & Painting Games
*Games where cells must be selectively shaded or colored according to rules*
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Norinori
- LITS
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Usowan
- Yajilin
- Kurotto

## 5. Island & Connectivity Games
*Games centered on connecting or isolating groups, islands, or clusters of cells*
- Hashiwokakero
- Akari
- Nurimisaki
- Sto-stone
- Satogaeri

## 6. Shape & Piece Placement Games
*Games involving the placement or movement of defined shapes or blocks within the grid*
- Chained Block
- Shakashaka
- Sashigane

## 7. Territory & Movement Games
*Games involving pieces or elements that move, migrate, or claim territory*
- Hitori *(moved — see note)*
- Mid-loop *(moved — see note)*

---

> ⚠️ **Taxonomy Note:** Several games sit at category boundaries. Each game above is assigned to exactly one category based on its **primary mechanic**. All 42 games are included exactly once across the 7 categories.
